title: onPartitionsRevoked hook on KafkaConsumerInterface.connect: v2 awaits it before unassigning, v1 fires it after unassigning
answers: how do I run code when kafka partitions are revoked
does the revoke hook run before or after unassign
onPartitionsRevoked consumer v1 vs v2 difference
react to rebalance in a nodejs kafka consumer
body:
KafkaConsumerInterface.connect (nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/index.ts) takes an optional second argument, `onPartitionsRevoked(revokedPartitions: Assignment[]) => Promise<void>`. Both consumer implementations must support it.
KafkaConsumerV2 awaits the hook before it unassigns the partitions. The analytics lanes run v2 (CONSUMER_USE_V2).
KafkaConsumer (v1, consumer-v1.ts) stores the hook in connect. Its revoke path calls the hook after unassign and resetRebalanceCoordination, fire-and-forget. Errors are only logged as `partition_revoked_handler_failed`.
When you write a hook: keep it fast, and don't count on it running before unassign. Under v1 it runs late and its failures never surface.
v1 only sees revokes because its `false` rebalance mode (where node-rdkafka rebalanced on its own) was removed in #105238. Don't bring that mode back, or the hook will never fire.
The v1 test in consumer-v1.test.ts sets `consumer['onPartitionsRevoked']` directly and checks that it is called with the revoked assignments.
